actions.name: Dispatch Hot
actions.description: As a standard action, the mech can transfer one operator into a vehicle stored in its cargo hold, after which the mech launches the stored vehicle at high speed using the race action. The pilot of the launched vehicle doesn't need to succeed at a Piloting check as part of the race action this turn.

description.value:
Prerequisite: Must have cargo hold system.

This system launches stored vehicles at high velocity.

Dispatch Hot (3 PP): Transfer an operator to a stored vehicle and launch it from the mech.
